children.name: Diamond 1
children.script:
import { Area2DNode, Node } from 'cleo'

/**
 * Duskwell -- something lying in the world for the player to take. Attach to an Area 2D that sees the
 * player's layer; its children are the visuals (a sprite), which bob.
 *
 *   kind = 'diamond'     +`amount` diamonds
 *   kind = 'heart'       heals `amount`
 *   kind = 'dash' | 'doubleJump' | 'wallJump'   a movement ability, for good
 *
 * The player decides what a kind does (DuskPlayer.collect); this only hands it over and goes.
 */
export default class DuskPickup extends Area2DNode {
  public kind: string = 'diamond'
  public amount: number = 1
  public bobHeight: number = 0.12
  public bobSpeed: number = 3

  private _time: number = 0
  private _taken: boolean = false
  private _base: number[] = []

  onStart() {
    this._time = (this.worldPosition[0] * 0.37) % 6.28
    this._base = this.children.map(c => c.position[1])
  }

  onUpdate(delta: number) {
    this._time += delta * this.bobSpeed
    const y = Math.sin(this._time) * this.bobHeight
    this.children.forEach((c, i) => {
      if (this._base[i] === undefined) return
      const p = c.position
      c.setPosition([p[0], this._base[i] + y, p[2]])
    })
  }

  onTriggerEnter(other: Node) {
    if (this._taken || typeof (other as any).collect !== 'function') return
    this._taken = true
    ;(other as any).collect(this.kind, this.amount)
    this.enabled = false
    this.remove()
  }
}

children.name: Checkpoint 1
children.script:
import { AnimatedSpriteNode, Area2DNode, Node } from 'cleo'

/**
 * Duskwell -- a checkpoint: a lamp the player lights by walking past it. Attach to an Area 2D that sees the
 * player's layer; its `Lamp` child is the sprite, dim until lit. Lighting it heals the player and makes it
 * where the player comes back after a death.
 */
export default class DuskCheckpoint extends Area2DNode {
  public litTint: number[] = [1, 1, 1]
  public unlitTint: number[] = [0.35, 0.35, 0.45]
  public healTo: number = 99

  private _lit: boolean = false
  private _lamp: AnimatedSpriteNode = null

  onStart() {
    this._lamp = this.getChildByName('Lamp')[0] as AnimatedSpriteNode
    if (this._lamp) this._lamp.tint = this.unlitTint as [number, number, number]
  }

  onTriggerEnter(other: Node) {
    const p = other as any
    if (typeof p.setRespawn !== 'function') return
    const here = this.worldPosition
    p.setRespawn(here[0], here[1] - this.size[1] / 2 + 0.01)
    p.heal?.(this.healTo)
    if (this._lit) return
    this._lit = true
    if (this._lamp) this._lamp.tint = this.litTint as [number, number, number]
    p.say?.('Checkpoint')
  }
}

children.script:
import { Node, UIRootNode, UITextNode } from 'cleo'

/**
 * Duskwell -- the HUD. Attach to the `HUD` screen-space UI Root; it reads the `Player` node every frame and
 * writes its widgets, found by name once:
 *
 *   Health     uiText   "HP 4 / 5"
 *   Diamonds   uiText   the diamonds carried
 *   Notice     uiText   the player's one-line message (a pickup, a checkpoint), empty otherwise
 */
export default class DuskHud extends UIRootNode {
  public playerName: string = 'Player'

  private _player: Node = null
  private _health: UITextNode = null
  private _diamonds: UITextNode = null
  private _notice: UITextNode = null

  onStart() {
    this._player = this.findNode(this.playerName) ?? null
    this._health = this._find('Health')
    this._diamonds = this._find('Diamonds')
    this._notice = this._find('Notice')
  }

  private _find(name: string): UITextNode {
    const queue: Node[] = [...this.children]
    while (queue.length) {
      const n = queue.shift()
      if (n.name === name && n instanceof UITextNode) return n
      queue.push(...n.children)
    }
    return null
  }

  onUpdate() {
    const p = this._player as any
    if (!p) return
    const health = `HP ${Math.max(0, Math.ceil(p.health ?? 0))} / ${p.maxHealth ?? 0}`
    if (this._health && this._health.text !== health) this._health.text = health
    const diamonds = `Diamonds ${p.diamonds ?? 0}`
    if (this._diamonds && this._diamonds.text !== diamonds) this._diamonds.text = diamonds
    const notice = p.notice ?? ''
    if (this._notice && this._notice.text !== notice) this._notice.text = notice
  }
}
